what_to_detect: A player can activate an activated ability of an object with no controller (a card in their hand or graveyard) because they own it.
near_miss: An activated ability of a card another player owns, which the deciding player cannot activate.

what_to_detect: A player who does not control an object can activate its activated ability because the ability says any player may activate it (an Activator$ Player line): the deciding player differs from the source's controller and can_play is true.
near_miss: An activated ability of an object another player controls that grants no such permission, which the deciding player cannot activate.
record_fields: the candidate line's Activator$ (read by verdict_bit's existing script_param)
